quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova introduces medium-voltage UPS to help accelerate (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova introduced its medium-voltage uninterruptible power supply (MV-UPS) for AI data centers, AI factories and other energy-intensive facilities: installed on the facility's medium-voltage network, it combines power conversion, controls and integrated energy storage as a 'stability block' so one coordinated system protects much larger blocks of critical load than low-voltage UPS and buffers sudden demand swings before they reach the grid or onsite gas turbines. GE Vernova expects to begin shipping MV-UPS systems in mid-2027, with energization of the first project expected in late 2027. It adds to GE Vernova's power-to-rack data-center offering (gas turbines, substations, HV/MV transformers, switchgear, EMS, power conversion); solid-state transformer technology is in development.
quarterly_data.figure: MV-UPS shipments from mid-2027; first project energization late 2027
